product: event-first IRL social network / real-world social marketplace

backend.durable_async_baseline: transactional outbox + versioned idempotent event contracts
backend.realtime_baseline: WebSocket + authoritative REST recovery when realtime scope is activated

data.objects: GCP Cloud Storage when object storage is required
data.runtime_truth_after_p0_006: Drizzle schema + ordered migrations + database-native invariants

valkey.activation_gate: measured latency, coordination or realtime need; PostgreSQL remains authoritative

pubsub.activation_gate: measured workload/reliability/ownership need beyond the transactional outbox baseline

cloud_tasks.activation_gate: provider/background-work reliability requirement that simpler execution cannot satisfy

bigquery.activation_gate: analytics volume/query needs exceed operational analytics tooling

stockholm_dr.activation_gate: measured RTO/RPO, safety or business-impact requirement

custom_ml_recommendations.activation_gate: rules-based recommendation baseline is proven insufficient with adequate behavioural evidence

service_extraction.activation_gate: measured independent scaling, reliability isolation or ownership/deployment need

mobile_delivery.ota: EAS Update with explicit runtimeVersion compatibility

operational_flags: PostgreSQL source of truth; cache only if activated; versioned and audited Admin controls
experiments: PostHog or equivalent product analytics/experimentation; never operational truth
analytics: PostHog baseline; warehouse deferred until justified
observability: OpenTelemetry + Sentry or equivalent implementation selected in Phase 0
